title: Messages stuck at the bottom of the chat — tuning the card's colours across themes

steps.path: Last round's option C in all six built-in themes (amber = not sure, red = didn't send)
steps.headline: Baseline: last round's option C. The card takes the theme's page colours, so it fights the bubble in every theme.
steps.changed: Nothing new, shown in all six themes so you can compare. Dark themes get a dark card in a light bubble; light themes get a pale card in a dark bubble.
steps.notice: This is what you said still felt off.

steps.path: The card's colours worked out from the bubble's own colour, gentle
steps.headline: Option D: the card is the bubble's own colour shifted toward amber or red, so it belongs to the bubble in every theme.
steps.changed: Same card shape, same place. Its fill is the bubble colour blended about one-fifth toward amber or red, with a stronger outline. Words and buttons use the bubble's own text colour: outlined Dismiss or Discard, filled Send again.
steps.notice: It's worked out the same way the file and reference pills inside a sent bubble already are: from the bubble's colours, so every theme, including community ones, gets a matching card without hand-tuning.
steps.risk: Send again is light where the bubble is dark (Light, Crème, YouCoded) and dark where it is light: always the opposite of the bubble so it stands out.

steps.path: The same as D with stronger colour
steps.headline: Option E: same as D but blended twice as far toward amber or red, so the warning reads louder.
steps.changed: The fill is the bubble colour blended about two-fifths toward amber or red. Everything else as in D.
steps.notice: Clearly amber or red at a glance in every theme.
steps.risk: On YouCoded's purple bubbles the amber turns peachy and the red turns pink-purple, because the colour is mixed with the purple.
